semiconductor_relevance: High — Amcoss Components specializes in optics and mechatronics for semiconductor manufacturing processes, making it a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: Amcoss Components designs, manufactures, and repairs high-quality optics and components specifically for photolithography, RTP, CVD, EPI, and metrology applications in the semiconductor sector. The company also provides automated and semi-automated equipment for wafer processing and offers customized temperature control solutions.
capabilities: High-quality optics for photolithography and metrology
Automated and semi-automated single wafer spin processing equipment

regional_presence.Austria: Amcoss is recognized as one of the top 4% of companies in Austria based on financial ratings, indicating a strong local presence.
